13.1 Tangent to a Curve at a Point

blocks.prompt:
1 The slope of the secant line through \(P(x, f(x))\) and \(Q(x + \delta x, f(x + \delta x))\) is
(\(P(x, f(x))\) aur \(Q(x + \delta x, f(x + \delta x))\) se guzarne wali secant line ka slope kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope = rise / run. Rise \(= f(x+\delta x) - f(x)\), run \(= (x + \delta x) - x = \delta x\).

book_ref.quote: Here \(\delta x\) is the increment in the value of \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
2 As \(\delta x \to 0\), the point \(Q\) approaches \(P\) and the secant line \(PQ\) becomes
(Jab \(\delta x \to 0\), point \(Q\) point \(P\) ke qareeb aata hai aur secant line \(PQ\) kya ban jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghoomti hui secant line \(P\) par tangent \(PT\) ban jati hai; us ka slope \(m_{\text{tan}} = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+\delta x)-f(x)}{\delta x}\) hai.

book_ref.quote: the secant line becomes the tangent line

blocks.prompt:
3 Why can we not put \(\delta x = 0\) directly in \(\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\)?
(\(\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\) mein seedha \(\delta x = 0\) kyun nahi rakh sakte?)

options.text: \(\frac{0}{0}\) banta hai jis ka koi matlab nahi

blocks.explanation: \(\delta x = 0\) rakhne se \(Q\) point \(P\) par aa jata hai aur \(\frac{f(x)-f(x)}{0} = \frac{0}{0}\) banta hai jis ka koi matlab nahi. Is liye pehle \(\delta x\) cancel karte hain, phir limit lete hain.

book_ref.quote: To find the slope of a line we need two points, but a tangent touches the curve at only one point

blocks.prompt:
4 The slope of the secant to \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) through the points where \(x = 1\) and \(x = 3\) is
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) ki secant ka slope, jo \(x = 1\) aur \(x = 3\) wale points se guzarti hai, kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: A secant cuts a curve at two points

blocks.prompt:
5 For \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3x\), the slope of the secant through \(x = 2\) and \(x = 2 + \delta x\) is
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 3x\) ke liye \(x = 2\) aur \(x = 2 + \delta x\) se guzarne wali secant ka slope kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(2+\delta x) - f(2) = 7\delta x + \delta x^{2}\); \(\delta x\) se taqseem karne par \(7 + \delta x\).

book_ref.quote: Working pattern: substitute, expand, cancel the common factor

blocks.prompt:
6 The slope of the tangent to \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3x\) at \(x = 2\) is
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 3x\) ki \(x = 2\) par tangent ka slope kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(m_{\text{tan}} = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}(7 + \delta x) = 7\).

book_ref.quote: We see that \(m_{\text{tan}}\) is the limit of \(m_{\text{sec}}\)

blocks.prompt:
7 The line through \((1, -2)\) with slope \(3\) is
(\((1, -2)\) se guzarne wali line jis ka slope \(3\) ho, us ki equation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(y - (-2) = 3(x - 1) \Rightarrow y = 3x - 5\).

book_ref.quote: To find the equation of a tangent you always need two things

blocks.prompt:
8 The tangent to \(y = x^{2} + 1\) at the point \((1, 2)\) is
(\(y = x^{2} + 1\) ki point \((1, 2)\) par tangent ki equation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \lim_{\delta x \to 0}(2 + \delta x) = 2\). Phir \(y - 2 = 2(x - 1)\), yaani \(y = 2x\). Check: \(x^{2} + 1 = 2x\) se \((x-1)^{2} = 0\), aik hi (dohra) root.

book_ref.quote: the line touches the curve at \(P\) and does not cut it again

f ki average rate of change (ausat sharah-e-tabdeeli)
f ke graph ke neeche area

options.text: f ki average rate of change

book_ref.quote: is called the instantaneous rate of change of

(Jab \(x\) \(1\) se \(2\) tak badle to \(f(x) = x^{3}\) ki average rate of change kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Its limit as \(x_{1} \to x\) (or \(\delta x \to 0\)) = instantaneous rate of change

blocks.prompt:
12 The average rate of change of \(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x}\) from \(x = 1\) to \(x = 4\) is
(\(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x}\) ki \(x = 1\) se \(x = 4\) tak average rate of change kya hai?)

blocks.prompt:

(Function \(f\) ko \(x\) par differentiable kab kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq: agar \(x \in D_{f}\) aur limit \(f'(x)\) mojood ho to \(f\) \(x\) par differentiable hai.

book_ref.quote: is said to be differentiable at

blocks.explanation: Derivative \(f'\) maloom karne ke amal ko differentiation kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The process of finding \(f'\) is called differentiation.

blocks.prompt:

(Unit mein derivative \(f'(x)\) ka doosra naam kya diya gaya hai?)

blocks.text: 13.2.1 Derivative as the rate of change of velocity

blocks.prompt:
16 A particle has position \(s(t)\). Its average velocity over the interval from \(t\) to \(t_{1}\) is
(Aik particle ki position \(s(t)\) hai. \(t\) se \(t_{1}\) tak us ki average velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Average velocity = position ki tabdeeli \(\div\) waqt ki tabdeeli, formula (i).

book_ref.quote: The average velocity over the interval from

blocks.prompt:
17 For \(s(t) = t^{2} + 2t\) metres, the average velocity over \([1, 3]\) is
(\(s(t) = t^{2} + 2t\) metres ke liye \([1, 3]\) par average velocity kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Each average velocity is the slope of a secant on the position graph

blocks.prompt:
18 For \(s(t) = t^{2} + 2t\) metres, the instantaneous velocity at \(t = 1\) is
(\(s(t) = t^{2} + 2t\) metres ke liye \(t = 1\) par instantaneous velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(s(1+\delta t) - s(1) = 4\delta t + \delta t^{2}\), is liye quotient \(4 + \delta t \to 4\) m/sec.

book_ref.quote: the average velocity becomes the instantaneous velocity

blocks.prompt:
19 For \(s(t) = t^{2}\), the average velocity from \(t = 2\) to \(t = 2 + \delta t\) is
(\(s(t) = t^{2}\) ke liye \(t = 2\) se \(t = 2 + \delta t\) tak average velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\dfrac{(2+\delta t)^{2} - 4}{\delta t} = 4 + \delta t\). Jab \(\delta t \to 0\), yeh \(4\) ki taraf jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Smaller intervals give average velocities closer and closer to the instantaneous velocity

blocks.prompt:
20 A particle's position is \(s(t) = 3t^{2} - t\) miles after \(t\) hours. Its instantaneous velocity at \(t = 2\) is
(Aik particle ki position \(t\) ghante baad \(s(t) = 3t^{2} - t\) miles hai. \(t = 2\) par instantaneous velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(s(2+\delta t) - s(2) = 11\delta t + 3\delta t^{2}\); \(\delta t\) se taqseem: \(11 + 3\delta t \to 11\).

book_ref.quote: the instantaneous velocity is the derivative of the position function

blocks.prompt:
21 Position is measured in metres and time in seconds. The unit of the instantaneous velocity is
(Position metres mein aur time seconds mein ho to instantaneous velocity ki unit kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity = position ki tabdeeli \(\div\) waqt ki tabdeeli, is liye unit metre per second hai.

book_ref.quote: Units: (unit of position) per (unit of time)

blocks.prompt:
22 The symbol \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) stands for
(Symbol \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) kis cheez ke liye hai?)

options.text: fixed \(\delta x\) ke liye \(\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x}\)

blocks.explanation: \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) aik hi symbol hai jo \(\lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x} = f'(x)\) ko zahir karta hai; yeh \(dy\) aur \(dx\) ki taqseem nahi.

book_ref.quote: and here it is not a quotient of

blocks.prompt:
23 The notation \(Df(x)\) for the derivative was used by
(Derivative ke liye notation \(Df(x)\) kis mathematician ne istemal kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Leibniz: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\); Newton: \(\dot{y}\); Lagrange: \(f'(x)\); Euler: \(Df(x)\).

book_ref.quote: Notations for the derivative of y = f(x) used by different mathematicians

blocks.prompt:
24 Newton's notation for the derivative of \(y\) is
(\(y\) ke derivative ke liye Newton ka notation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Newton letter ke oopar dot lagate the: \(\dot{y}\). \(y'\) Lagrange ka, \(Dy\) Euler ka aur \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) Leibniz ka notation hai.

book_ref.quote: Newton used it mainly for rates of change with respect to time

blocks.prompt:
25 If \(y = f(x)\) and \(y + \delta y = f(x + \delta x)\), then \(\delta y\) equals
(Agar \(y = f(x)\) aur \(y + \delta y = f(x + \delta x)\) ho to \(\delta y\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf se \(y = f(x)\) minus karein: \(\delta y = f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\).

book_ref.quote: subtract \(y = f(x)\) from both sides of (iv) to get the change in \(y\) alone

blocks.prompt:
26 The derivative of \(f\) at the point \(x = a\) is
(\(f\) ka point \(x = a\) par derivative kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x + \delta x\) ki jagah \(x\) aur \(x\) ki jagah \(a\) rakhne se: \(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\).

book_ref.quote: is called the derivative or gradient of

blocks.prompt:
27 Using \(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\), the derivative of \(f(x) = x^{2} + x\) at \(a = 2\) is
(\(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\) se \(f(x) = x^{2} + x\) ka \(a = 2\) par derivative kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Either form earns full marks if the working is correct

blocks.prompt:
28 For \(y = x^{2}\), which statement is correct?
(\(y = x^{2}\) ke liye kaunsa bayan durust hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) fraction nahi, is liye \(d\) cancel nahi hote. Definition se \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{2}) = 2x\).

book_ref.quote: Cancelling the \(d\)'s in \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) to get \(\frac{y}{x}\)

blocks.text: 13.3.2 Finding f'(x) by Definition of Derivative

blocks.prompt:
29 In finding \(f'(x)\) by definition, the first step is to
(Definition se \(f'(x)\) nikalte waqt pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Step I: \(f(x+\delta x)\); Step II: \(f(x+\delta x) - f(x)\); Step III: \(\delta x\) se taqseem; Step IV: \(\delta x \to 0\) par limit.

book_ref.quote: can be found by the following four steps

blocks.prompt:
30 Which of the following is NOT a name for finding a derivative by the four steps?
(Chaar qadmon se derivative nikalne ke liye in mein se kaunsa naam NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar qadam wale tareeqe ko differentiation by definition, ab-initio ya first principles kehte hain. Quotient rule baad ka shortcut rule hai (13.6).

book_ref.quote: The method of finding derivatives by this process is called differentiation by definition

blocks.prompt:
31 For \(f(x) = 3x^{2}\), \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\) equals
(\(f(x) = 3x^{2}\) ke liye \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Expand \((x+\delta x)^{n}\), cancel, take out \(\delta x\)

blocks.prompt:
32 By definition, the derivative of \(f(x) = 5x^{2} - x\) is
(Definition se \(f(x) = 5x^{2} - x\) ka derivative kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x+\delta x) - f(x) = 10x\,\delta x + 5(\delta x)^{2} - \delta x\); \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(10x + 5\delta x - 1 \to 10x - 1\).

book_ref.quote: Putting \(\delta x = 0\) in Step III before simplifying

blocks.prompt:
33 To find the derivative of \(\sqrt{x}\) by definition, the key algebra step is
(\(\sqrt{x}\) ka derivative definition se nikalte waqt asal algebra ka qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upar neeche \(\sqrt{x+\delta x} + \sqrt{x}\) se zarb dein: numerator \(\delta x\) ban jata hai jo cancel ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the key algebra move is rationalizing the numerator

blocks.prompt:
34 For \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\), after rationalizing, \(\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\) equals
(\(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) ke liye rationalize karne ke baad \(\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upar \((\sqrt{x+\delta x})^{2} - (\sqrt{x})^{2} = \delta x\) banta hai, jo neeche wale \(\delta x\) se cancel hota hai: \(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{x+\delta x} + \sqrt{x}}\).

book_ref.quote: On top \((p-q)(p+q) = p^{2} - q^{2}\) removes the square roots

blocks.prompt:
35 The gradient of \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) at \(x = 16\) is
(\(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) ka \(x = 16\) par gradient kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Results: \(\frac{d}{dx}(c) = 0\)

blocks.prompt:

(Definition se \(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x}\) ke liye \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Common denominator: \(\dfrac{x - (x + \delta x)}{x(x + \delta x)} = \dfrac{-\delta x}{x(x + \delta x)}\). \(\delta x\) se taqseem aur limit se \(-\dfrac{1}{x^{2}}\).

book_ref.quote: With fractions, the key algebra move is taking a common denominator.

(Agar \(y = \dfrac{1}{x^{2}}\) ho to \(\left.\dfrac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=2}\) kya hai?)

(Step III mein numerator aur denominator se \(\delta x\) cancel karna kyun jaiz hai?)

options.text: \(\delta x \ne 0\) jab ke woh \(0\) ki taraf ja raha hai

blocks.explanation: \(\delta x\) zero ki taraf jata hai magar kabhi zero ke barabar nahi hota, is liye us se taqseem jaiz hai.

book_ref.quote: we may cancel \(\delta x\) only because \(\delta x \ne 0\)

blocks.prompt:
40 For \(f(x) = x^{3}\), \(\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\) equals

blocks.explanation: \((x+\delta x)^{3} - x^{3} = 3x^{2}\delta x + 3x(\delta x)^{2} + (\delta x)^{3}\); \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(3x^{2} + 3x\,\delta x + (\delta x)^{2}\).

options.text: Jo function kisi point par continuous ho woh wahan differentiable hota hai
